### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/spec-changes.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/spec-changes.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c577e66635944b8c911e9d38adde34669e68400a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `dcc4c2ef1453a0a6538691e7e39f610253c02e45` — the merge of head `1c0dc7ad546dfd04c6f252e51f16e91f138f6587` into base `c577e66635944b8c911e9d38adde34669e68400a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin dcc4c2ef1453a0a6538691e7e39f610253c02e45 && git checkout dcc4c2ef1453a0a6538691e7e39f610253c02e45
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c577e66635944b8c911e9d38adde34669e68400a 1c0dc7ad546dfd04c6f252e51f16e91f138f6587 && git checkout -B drift-repro c577e66635944b8c911e9d38adde34669e68400a && git merge --no-ff 1c0dc7ad546dfd04c6f252e51f16e91f138f6587

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c577e66635944b8c911e9d38adde34669e68400a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: 78/78 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1c0dc7ad546dfd04c6f252e51f16e91f138f6587`

Head unmoved across the review (re-read at the end: same sha, `open`). Base sha `569d4d2dbf` (merge base with `origin/main` `70ce8022c4`).

### ① Derived judgments
1. **Text only — holds, mechanically.** Own TypeScript-AST instrument over base and head `git archive` trees: for each of the 26 changed entry files, every non-prose property's source text (`id`, `surface`, `from`/`to`, everything not `replacement`/`reason`/`acceptanceCriteria`), every `//` and `/* */` comment token, every non-entry statement (imports) and the property set/order are byte-identical base→head. 26/26 files differ only in the three prose values; 0 untouched entry files differ. A raw-diff sanity pass finds no `+`/`-` line that is not a string-literal fragment or a `reason:`/`replacement:` label.
2. **Truth of each rewrite — holds; no lesson lost, softened or overstated.** Read in full against single REST reads (36 in-repo ids + comments; `#6075`, `#11846` 404 on issues and pulls; `cloud#1651` 403):
   - `18.driver-sql-unresolvable-where-column-refused` (14): `#8790` maintainer 2026-08-15 「接受你的所有建议」 → refuse both halves `INVALID_FILTER`/400 naming the column, ladder keeps projection/ORDER-BY recoveries — text says exactly that. `#7929` ruling B 2026-08-12: `INVALID_FILTER` stops echoing `$field` operands for every caller, full text to server log — text says exactly that. `#8926` option A 2026-08-16 (MySQL joins the one shared predicate) — "Addendum 2026-08-16" plus the paragraph already stating it. `#8371` Option 2: refuse relation/formula/plain-scalar head at both doors (protocol `assertFilterFieldsExist` + engine `assertFilterIsMaterializable`) — text matches. `#3821` premise ("rows matter more than their order", unsortable query returns rows) is on `main` at `sql-driver.ts:7168` and the recovery test header.
   - `18.system-metrics-jsdoc-durations-unit-in-key` (12) and `18.kernel-runtime-config-timeout-unit-in-key` (11): `#15939` ruling A 2026-09-11 (batch #65 direction stands: refuse JSDoc-names-unit-describe-does-not; 21 rows remediated per file first; PR `#17635` lands last into a clean tree) — text matches. `#14478` ruling B (recorded `5518649320`) and population ruling B 2026-09-05 (`5548763981`: every authored + runtime-emitted duration, exempt only by declaration on the schema) — the 13 boilerplate entries now name both dates and the exemption clause correctly; the "unit in key name or unit-carrying value" gloss is the ruling's own wording. `#15678`/`#15679` are the kernel-/system-directory rounds by title.
   - Six more, prose most changed: `kernel-context-preview-mode-retired` (dead `#11846` → spec CHANGELOG `0c2334f`, `context.zod.ts`, retired-key header: 2026-08-27 Option A remove, zero consumers; `cloud#1651` → CHANGELOG records closed 2026-08-26, `RuntimeMode` 0 hits, `ArtifactKernelFactory` 20+ hits never touching `previewMode`; `serve.ts:3938-3952` reads `OS_PREVIEW_MODE` only to push preview-domain wildcards onto better-auth `trustedOrigins` — measured). `driver-aggregate-undeclared-key-aliases-removed` (`#4984` "tests green, rule dead" verbatim; `#4484` no tombstone because nothing parses a driver object, `5158609619`; `#5540` "two adapters answered differently and both incompletely" verbatim; `#6011` maintainer 「roles 别名现在就关闭」; `#6321`/`#6404` fixed order, "reverse yields red nobody can explain" verbatim). `driver-sql-distinct-bare-filter-typed` (dead `#6075` → driver-sql CHANGELOG `d367f03`: five drivers followed `DriverQuery`; `#5499` freeze 2026-08-05, fully lifted 2026-08-11 `5252526378`; `#6320` sql half dispatched, memory half frozen). `driver-sql-upsert-cross-row-identity-merge-refused` (`#8621` option A, `#8755` option A rival key, `#8622` id insert-only after measured PK rewrite, `#8807` maintainer 2026-08-15 principle). `kernel-health-check-and-hot-reload` (`#3733` parse success/key dropped silently; `#4914` 2026-08-04 keep `HotReloadConfigSchema` with `HotReloadManager`; `#11825` 2026-08-25 container retired, classes host-driven; `#14519` two tenant timeouts, unit in JSDoc only; `#15626` landed gate + tenant rename). `kernel-compatibility-matrix` (`#18669` ruling A 2026-09-17: last two keys no closed type could express, hours + fractional seconds, no new type, no narrowing; batch `#158` → `.changeset/18075-agreement-shape-is-an-offence.md` on `main`). `driver-turso` (`#16024` per-key ruling 2026-09-06 after three unread keys measured).
   - `cloud#1651` is gone from all author-shown fields of the 26; the four remaining `cloud#` sites are in other families (boundary, below).
3. **Census — reproduced exactly with my own instrument** (`#\d{4,5}\b` over evaluated `replacement`/`reason`/`acceptanceCriteria`, `surface` separate; 718 files, 300 `entry` object literals, 0 unevaluable; retired-key/def files export a string, so none are author-shown). Base: whole tree **843**, `driver-` 44 (0/44/0, 25 distinct), `kernel-` 44 (1/41/2, 11), `system-` 44 (0/42/2, 6), `surface` 7. Head: whole tree **711**, the three families **0/0/0**, `engine-`/`ui-`/`plugin-` still 0, `surface` 7. Lit control `17.aggregation-node-distinct-retired`: 7 (1/6/0) before and after. Dark control: 794 `//` lines with a tracker id before and after. Short `#N{1,3}` sites in the three families 0/9/10 → 0/0/0 (the 19 decision-batch sites).
4. **Widened pin — holds, nothing weakened.** `FAMILY` is derived from the built `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR` by the six prefixes; each block (`surface` + replacement + why + verify, laid out as `meta.ts:523-525`) is asserted present in stdout, then `block.match(TRACKER_ID)?.[0]` must be undefined — so any id returning to any covered entry's four fields fails the third `it`. Anti-vacuity: `REWRITTEN` 29 → 55 (all 26 ids of this stage present), every prefix must select ≥1 entry, detector lit/dark self-test unchanged. The three assertions are textually identical to base; only `COVERED_PREFIXES` and `REWRITTEN` widened.
5. **Generated artifacts — exact.** Parsed `registry.ts` at base and head: 300 semantic entries both sides, exactly the 26 ids differ, all prose-only, 0 non-prose differences; all 300 head registry entries match the head entry files byte-for-byte on `surface`/`reason`/`replacement`/`acceptanceCriteria`. `spec-changes.json` (12 lines) and the upgrade guide (6) change only the three protocol-17 `driver-` rationales, mirrored from the entries. CI at head: 35 check-runs, 0 failures; `Lint & Repo Gates` (runs `check:migration-registry`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:generated --reconcile-only`, `check:doc-authoring`) success.
6. **Changeset — every sentence true.** `'@objectstack/spec': patch`; `Clause-②: no` stands alone on its own line; "some of which no longer resolve" (two 404s), "ADR ids are kept", "text only", "generated … carry the same text" all verified above.

- 68 short `#N{1,3}` decision-batch-style sites remain in other families' prose fields (87 at base; this PR removed 19).
